mode: Window-free egui and unit/lint checks only. No desktop, native-window or screenshot-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Current-image and New-document default dialogs in light/dark themes with fixed reachable Apply/Cancel actions, scrollable grouped fields/policy choices, staged cancellation preserving exact preference bytes and document/history. Repeated layout passes; one real undoable resize and remembered-size update per application. Existing save/reopen/new-image persistence coverage retained.

unit.scope: Stale document revision rejects the resize draft without changing the snapshot.

limits: Classic owns dialog presentation through CanvasSize/StartupSize view data; host retains tab/revision guards, typed resize commands and preference persistence. Existing top-left anchoring and off-canvas preservation semantics are unchanged. Native/rendered visual parity remains unqualified under the user restriction.
